param: Λ Recruitment (birth) rate of humans into Susceptible
β Effective transmission (successful infection) rate (S infected by I); used in mass-action term β*S*I
q Correction parameter for reinfection term (probability/scaling of reinfection relative to primary infection)
σ Immunity waning (drop-out) rate from Recovered to Susceptible (Recovered → Susceptible)
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments)
